name: Current daily price of various commodities from various markets (mandis)
organization: Government of India: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare via the Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India, data.gov.in
dataset: OGD resource 9ef84268-d588-465a-a308-a864a43d0070: state, district, market, commodity, variety, grade, arrival date, minimum / maximum / modal price (INR per quintal)
geography: India: market level (filtered to potato, Punjab)
frequency: Daily (latest available observation date, not real-time)
licence: Government Open Data License - India (GODL-India), as stated on the resource page
usageNotes: Requires a free personal API key (DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY). Arrival quantity is shown only where the source supplies it. A market/date with no record is shown as 'No observation available', never estimated.
integrationNote: NOT verified live: api.data.gov.in reset the TLS connection from the build network on 2026-10-07 (curl and Node). The adapter is unit-tested on the documented response shape; a file-import fallback (CLI import-mandi) uses the same validation. Verify with your API key from a network that can reach the host.
